name: VisuPro™
description: Designed for emerging presbyopes (ages 36-44) experiencing near-vision problems, offering a cost-effective transition to progressive lenses.
features: Focus Max Optimization
Binocular Harmonization Technology™
Two lifestyle-based designs: All Day & Flex
Quicker adaptation than progressive lenses
use_case: Ideal for early presbyopes who need help with near-vision tasks but are not ready for full progressive lenses.

name: MySV®
description: Personalized single vision lenses that compensate for prescriptions in all meridians, providing wider peripheral views.
features: Backside free form technology
360˚ Visual Comfort™
Optimized base curve for larger frames
Individualized based on position of wear
use_case: For patients needing a personalized single vision lens with enhanced visual acuity and wider views, beyond 'one-size-fits-all'.

name: Sync III™
description: A single vision lens with a 'boost zone' at the bottom to help relax eye muscles and alleviate digital eye strain.
features: Distance power with a lower 'boost zone'
Three boost zone power options (+0.57D, +0.95D, +1.32D)
Available in clear, photochromic, and polarized
Reduces strain from digital screens and near tasks
use_case: Perfect for single vision wearers of any age who spend significant time on digital devices and experience symptoms of Digital Eye Strain (DES).

name: iD Single Vision®
description: A bi-aspheric design that offers an expanded peripheral viewing area and edge-to-edge clarity, especially for higher prescriptions.
features: Integrated Dual Surface™ free form technology
Expanded peripheral viewing
Edge-to-edge clarity with reduced distortion
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements
use_case: Patients with high prescriptions who want thinner, lighter lenses with the widest possible field of clear vision.

name: Single Vision iQ™
description: Utilizes progressive lens technology in a single vision design for enhanced optics and reduced peripheral distortion.
features: Spherical front with custom back surfacing
Backside design technology from PALs
Reduced distortion in peripheral areas
Requires OC and monocular PD measurements
use_case: For patients who want the optical benefits of high-end progressive lens technology in a single vision lens for a wider, clearer visual field.
